	text = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_policy = dop_favor_the_clergy_catholic }
			glorpui_svh_policy_core = { KEY = dop_favor_the_clergy LAW = distribution_of_power_law }
			policy:dop_favor_the_clergy = { NOT = { is_locked_for = PREV } }
		}
		localization_key = GLORP_UI_SVH_SPIRITUALIST_P_DOP_FAVOR_THE_CLERGY
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = empty_text
	}
}

				has_advance = university_advance
				AND = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance } has_embraced_institution = institution:renaissance }
